Name: Custom Music Player
Author: Jarajtekreir
Description:
[b]Description[/b] A lightweight Stardew Valley mod that lets you listen to your own MP3 files in-game with a custom menu, hotkeys, and playback controls.
[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] installed.[/*]
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5099]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (recommended for in-game settings and keybindings).[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game once using SMAPI. The mod will automatically generate a
[code]UserTracks[/code]folder inside the mod's directory.[/*]
[/list][b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Custom Music Menu:[/b] Press
[code]J[/code](default) to open an in-game menu where you can browse and play your favorite
[code].mp3[/code]tracks.[/*]
[*][b]Playback Controls:[/b] Easily switch between sequential and shuffle modes, pause, resume, or skip tracks using in-menu buttons or keyboard shortcuts.[/*]
[*][b]Fully Configurable:[/b] Customize all hotkeys and toggle the mod on or off seamlessly using the Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*][b]Multi-Language Support:[/b] Includes built-in localization for multiple languages.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (Stardew Modding API)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5099]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Highly recommended for configuration)[/*]
[*]Place your
[code].mp3[/code]music files into the automatically generated
[code]UserTracks[/code]folder.[/*]
[/list][b]Shout outs[/b] Huge thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community and the creators of SMAPI and NAudio for making custom audio development possible!
